decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that visibly supports the firm's stated push toward automated, future-ready precast production and extends its established system offering, management would continue backing it rather than reverse a recent public commitment.

Because this de-shuttering robot builds directly on the firm's core automation capabilities, fits its broad integrated portfolio, and shows no clear evidence of failure yet, management would be inclined to persist with it.

The profile storage robot complements the firm's end-to-end plant automation strategy and, given the firm's R&D orientation and recent investment, management would likely treat any early uncertainty as temporary and keep it on the market.

Since the automatic shuttering robot is closely tied to the firm's announced strategic direction and has already been publicly presented, management would tend to maintain the product rather than abandon sunk development and launch efforts after only a short time.
